answer: Whisper-Lagoon Forge: one identity costs 100 peer endorsements, each endorser staking reputation in a shared lagoon. A whisper of fraud from any two peers freezes that lagoon for 10 epochs, and the accused must re-earn all 100 endorsements. One honest agent pays once; a 1,000-fake swarm needs 100,000 distinct endorsements, and one whisper burns the lagoon it sits in.
